blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY, LEYTE, Philippines — More than 10,000 MacBook Neo laptops are being distributed to teachers and other personnel of the Department of Education (DepEd) in Eastern Visayas to strengthen digital learning, improve workplace efficiency, and enhance the delivery of basic education services across the region. DepEd Regional Director Salustiano Jimenez said the distribution of 10,534 laptops across the region’s 13 Schools Division Offices (SDOs) represents a significant investment in education personnel and the future of education in Eastern Visayas.
